utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Faye — 8:00 works. Can you send me the exact pickup time for Monday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I can do Monday pickup after school, around 3:15. If that changes, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. I really appreciate it — I’ll let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep—Mia first, then Sam, and we’re still on for 7:30. I’ll double-check with everyone so there’s no mix-up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can handle the carpool this week if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, Leo — thanks. We’ve just got three of us tomorrow, so I can ride with whoever’s easiest.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem — I can take you tomorrow. Just send me the pickup time and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks — we’ve got the 8:00 drop-off covered Monday through Friday. If you send me who needs a ride each day, I’ll keep the pairings simple.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll send you the daily rider list so you can keep it simple. Thanks for covering the 8:00 drop-off this week.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — send it over whenever you’re ready, and I’ll sort the pairings out simply.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, 7:30 still gives us plenty of cushion to get everyone there on time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, 7:30 works for me — let’s keep the carpool simple and pair everyone up by who needs a ride each day.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good to me — keep it simple and just let me know who needs a ride each day.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — we’ve only got three for tomorrow, so that should be easy to fit. I’ll keep track of the drivers and riders so we stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I be ready, and who’s picking up first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll confirm the pickup order and text you the exact time once I lock it in. If anything changes, I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note 7:30 a.m. at 124 Maple Street for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — thanks, Opal. I’ll pass that along and keep an eye out if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — just let me know if the pickup changes, and I’ll update my notes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I’m a bit scattered, so having the carpool plan repeated helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ve got you on the carpool list, and I’ll keep the timing and pickup details coming.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate you keeping me in the loop. I might miss a detail, so the repeated timing and pickup info helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam — could you cover the afternoon pickup on Thursday and Friday? I’ve got the morning drop-offs this week.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — I can cover the afternoon pickup on Thursday and Friday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thursday works for me — just confirm when you can, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll confirm the exact pickup time tonight, and I can meet you out front by your house.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Hana — I’ll be out front and ready.
